backgrounds: A single set used for the entire episode: a cozy stop-motion apartment living room at night. Two felt/clay-textured puppet characters sit side by side on a brown couch facing forward (talk-show-style, facing camera rather than each other). Behind them is a floor-to-ceiling window showing a blurred nighttime city skyline with lit windows in high-rise buildings, flanked by sheer curtains. To the left is a side table with a lamp, and a beige door/wall with small framed photos. The rest of the room recedes into a soft-focus background suggesting a dining area and additional furniture. The only non-living-room shots are plain black title/end cards with text (intro card and 'Episode 16' / 'NOTHING' caption overlays).
props: Brown fabric couch with a plaid (tan/brown check) throw pillow
Traditional lamp with a warm-lit bell-shaped fabric shade
Small framed photographs on the side table and on the wall
A dark mug and a white ceramic mug on the side table
An old boxy television set (retro CRT-style) visible in the background
A copper/bronze vase-shaped decorative object on a further table
City skyline visible through the window (lit apartment/office windows)
A folded white baby onesie/garment the woman holds and folds in her lap throughout the scene
Woman's pearl stud earrings and a ring
Man's round black-framed glasses and dark suit with tie
lighting_notes: Warm, soft interior lighting dominated by the practical lamp on the side table, contrasted with cool blue-toned light from the night skyline through the window behind the characters. This warm-foreground/cool-background split gives the shot depth and a moody, intimate sitcom-living-room feel. Lighting stays constant across the whole episode (single continuous scene, no time-of-day change).
color_palette: warm caramel/brown (couch, woman's sweater, wood furniture)
cool navy/blue-gray (night sky and city skyline background)
warm amber/yellow (lamp glow, title card text)
flesh tone with visible felted texture (character skin)
visual_complexity_notes: The set is a single, moderately detailed but static living-room backdrop with soft background blur (shallow depth of field) that keeps almost all visual complexity out of focus except the two characters in the foreground. This is a deliberate choice typical of the format: one recurring set reused across episodes, characters seated in fixed talk-show-style blocking, minimal camera/set variation, so all comedic and expressive weight falls on the puppets' exaggerated faces and line delivery rather than on environment or scene changes.
